images.content: Character sheet 'Character A': 6-view turnaround (front, front-left, left, right, back-right, back), proportion sheet, face & expressions (neutral, happy, sad, surprised, angry), hair construction (fringe, bun, long curls), clothing breakdown, technical guides, modular view (bald head)
Group sheet: boy_yellow_hoodie, brown-haired girl with glasses (labelled 'Character B'), white-haired girl ('C'); turnarounds, hair construction, clothing geometry, key animation; bottom row line-up
Blender screenshot: boy, brown-haired girl, white-haired girl rigged side by side ('Production Rigs')
Advanced technical references 'Character [A]': facial topology & rig controls, hand topology & finger rig, body & clothing topology, skeleton & skin weights, hair geometry & material spec

Facial rig: brows, eyelid tracking, jaw rotation, mouth corners; blendshape matrix (neutral, blink, left/right eye closed, squint, wide-open, smile, frown, surprise, sadness, anger, confusion, laugh, mouth open); eye & mouth/jaw controls
Hand topology & finger rigging blueprint (labelled character_b_reference_01): 5 fingers with MCP/PIP/DIP, thumb opposition, 12 hand poses, hand-object contact, weight guides
Technical blueprint 'Character A': body & clothing topology, joint deformation, rigging & armature, body animation poses (standing, arms raised, sitting, walking, running, squatting)

Skeletal hierarchy & skin weight blueprint (labelled character_b_reference_01; outline shows the WHITE-HAIRED girl in a dress): bone tree root-pelvis-spine01-spine02-chest-neck-head, clavicles, thigh-shin-foot-toe, fingers
Complete body armature & control rig (brown-haired girl): hierarchy, joint orientation, skin weight distribution, joint deformation tests

3D hair geometry & groom blueprint (character_a_reference_01): structure, main volume, clump construction, wool fibre structure, curl & wave construction, bun & accessory construction, density, editable components
Hair rig & secondary motion blueprint 'Character A': bun, scalp, fringe spline, side-lock chains, back curl chains, collision volumes, spring/damping, overlapping action
Garment construction & turnaround: shirt, vest, bloomer shorts, boots; exploded layering; mesh topology; seams & details (embroidery, buttons); joint deformations & cloth-collision boundaries

Material & texture specification (character_a_reference_01): hair/wool, skin (soft matte vinyl + SSS), shirt, vest boucle, shorts felted wool, boots fleece, glasses; PBR map requirements; lighting validation
UV mapping sheet: seams, packed UV map, head/face, hair & accessories, clothing & shoes, texel density
Hand anatomy & contact zones, grasp types (precision pinch, power grasp, open-hand support), pick-up sequence, holding & manipulation, environment & character contact (feet, chair, table)

Validation sheet: neutral pose (F, 3/4, S, B) with skeleton, joint deformation, facial deformation tests (neutral, smile, surprise, sad, eyes closed), hand & finger deformation, hair & clothing collision, full-body animation tests (walk, run, jump, landing)
Geometry & material analysis + armature overlay + animation & interaction test (walk, sit on chair, wave)
